concerns.text: Consumer-before-producer field mismatch: T104's convergence monitor 'flags iterations with max_iterations > 100 or tolerance < 1e-4', but T101's producer schema for convergence_log.json is [{iteration_id, sample_size, converged, max_iterations, error_message}] — no 'tolerance' field is ever written. The consumer reads a field no producer emits; either T101 must log tolerance or T104 must drop that criterion.

T103 asserts split_half_results.json 'contains a binary replication status', but T102 defines that file's schema as aggregated per-sample-size records [{sample_size, kernel, replication_rate, iterations}] — rates, not per-iteration binary outcomes. T103's verification condition cannot be checked against the artifact its producer (T102) actually emits; align the asserted content with T102's output schema or have T102 also emit per-iteration binary records.

All 'verified completed work' items are rendered as unchecked boxes ('- [ ]') despite the header stating they are verified complete and must not be redone. This invites an implementer to re-execute preserved work, breaking the intended ordering (reopen only T101–T107). Mark them checked or reformat as a non-checklist block.
